basis: Contract16aae7f0 distinguishes committed raw axes, prepared native exit, conversion and actual Python return. Layout4cf7 provides three native-exit phases but does not grant completed-call authority from ENTERED or a lone flag.

clarification.NOT_ENTERED_0: No native target invocation entered for this reserved component cell.
clarification.ENTERED_1: The once-only invocation has entered. Any subset of raw axes may be unobserved, staged or committed; do not infer completed native wrapper exit or caller return.
clarification.RAW_EXIT_PREPARED_2: All intended applicable raw-axis publications and the raw wrapper exit metadata have been prepared. This is not the instant the target API returns, Python conversion, caller-observed wrapper return, successful API semantics or publication of a live capability.
clarification.controlled_LastError_escape: A fake error transport escaping after scalar and error-definition publication but before its own return retains those two committed axes. Error-value and count remain uncommitted, native_exit_phase remains ENTERED1, RAW_EXIT bit stays clear and conversion_phase remains NOT_STARTED0. The harness copies this partial cell as data.
clarification.flags: RAW_EXIT flag is separate metadata. Interruption between setting that flag and publishing phase2 may retain flag set with phase1. Never promote phase or missing axes from a flag, target side effect, initialized scratch, elapsed time or diagnostic.
clarification.atomicity: Each axis commit and the separate phase transition are distinct observations. No whole-cell atomic transaction, OS-return atomicity, cross-process survival or implicit fault recovery is claimed. Readers require the future reviewed acquire/quiescent bridge.

change_boundary: Prospective clarification for the independent fake-target oracle before source build or execution. It changes no frozen contract, layout, source, expected scientific output or prior result. A peer must check coherence before build binding.
